footer.odor_model: Odor model: odor predictions on this page come from the graph neural network of this site's odor predictor, trained on data from The Good Scents Company and Leffingwell & Associates (Sanchez-Lengeling et al., 2019, arXiv:1910.10685, CC BY-NC), curated and merged by OpenPOM (Barsainyan et al., 2023); the raw data and odor labels are not redistributed here. The model and its predictions are for non-commercial academic demonstration only.
